document_reference: imgui.h, 'Dear ImGui end-user API functions' section
extracted_claim: Dear ImGui uses immediate mode GUI: call Begin()/End() pairs to create windows, call widget functions each frame to both declare UI and retrieve results. No retained widget tree. NewFrame() starts a frame, Render() finalizes draw data. GetDrawData() returns vertex lists for backend rendering. ImDrawList is a dynamic mesh builder (per-window). ImDrawVert = pos + uv + col (20 bytes). ImTextureID is backend-specific (default ImU64).
implementation_relevance: HSE has no GUI. ImGui is the standard C++ immediate mode GUI for game engines.

topic: ImGui Vertex Buffer and Draw Command Structure
extracted_claim: ImDrawCmd contains: ImTextureID texture_id, unsigned int elem_count, int clip_rect[4], int vtx_offset, int idx_offset. ImDrawListSplitter splits draw list into layers for out-of-order rendering then flattens. ImDrawData contains: int CmdListsCount, ImDrawList** CmdLists, int DisplayPos[2], int DisplaySize[2], int FramebufferScale[2].
implementation_relevance: ImGui's draw command structure maps directly to OpenGL draw calls — each ImDrawCmd becomes a glDrawElements call.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE renderer does not handle GUI draw lists

document_reference: imgui.h, Context creation and access section
extracted_claim: ImGui requires: CreateContext() → per-frame NewFrame() → widget calls → Render() → GetDrawData() → backend renders. ImGuiIO carries: mouse/keyboard/gamepad inputs, time, configuration flags. ImGuiPlatformIO connects platform/renderer backends. Backend flags: ImGuiBackendFlags_RendererHasTextures (since v1.9198). FontAtlas bakes multiple fonts into single texture.
implementation_relevance: Integrating ImGui with HSE requires creating an OpenGL backend that uploads ImDrawData vertex/index buffers.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE would need ImGui backend integration
